title: MS/TP: Make alignment consistent
description:
This dissector is mostly tab aligned (and the modelines and
.editorconfig file have it that way), but there are some blocks
of code with 2 space alignment. Make it all tab aligned.

notes.body: The code with 2 byte alignment was possibly taken directly from https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc8163/ (Appendix B), or vice versa. (Appendix D seems to have Wireshark output.)
